tools.name: search_ai_tools
tools.description: Find AI tools for a task or need (e.g. "edit podcast audio", "AI video avatars", "SEO keyword research"), ranked by real web traffic. Optional filters: category, free plan only, max monthly price in USD. Returns tools with pricing, rank and a link to each tool's AIWiseRank page.

tools.name: get_ai_tool
tools.description: Everything AIWiseRank knows about one AI tool: summary, category rank, global traffic rank and 7/30-day trend, pricing and free plan, score, top alternatives and links.

tools.name: best_ai_tools
tools.description: The most-used AI tools in a category, ranked by real web traffic, with pricing and links. Categories: Software Engineering, Design & Creative, AI Models, Customer Support, Writing & Content, Productivity, Marketing & SEO, Data Analytics, Video Production, Sales Intelligence.

tools.name: compare_ai_tools
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 4 AI tools: traffic rank, trend, pricing, free plan, score and alternatives.

tools.name: list_ai_tool_categories
tools.description: The AI tool categories AIWiseRank ranks, with how many tools each has and its most-visited tool.

tools.name: llm_api_pricing
tools.description: API token prices (USD per 1M input/output tokens) for current AI models across providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI and more), with ARC-AGI-2 and SWE-bench Verified scores where published. Sort by cheapest, best ARC-AGI-2 or best SWE-bench.

tools.name: ai_traffic_report
tools.description: Which AI tools gained and lost real-world usage in a month: key takeaways, biggest risers and fallers, category momentum. Defaults to the latest month.
